events.title: Hector Lugo Jazz/Latin Trio
events.description: Trio Caribe/The Caribbean Trio Drawing from the rich musical traditions of the Caribbean this trio of Bay Area standouts offers exciting interpretations of Latin and jazz standards and a few hidden gems of the Caribbean songbook. Tight Afro-Caribbean grooves, soulful vocals and daring improvisation propel their music, yet they're also comfortable in the intimate space [...]
